3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I was eagerly waiting for the decision of the Supreme Court regarding the Emergency Act. I stood up from my chair and looked out the window in my office.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Petr was with me too. He was slouching on the couch at the right side of the office and staring at the ceiling.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: The emergency decree was tough on all of my team. We were constantly battling with an opposition against our security measures.

10.speaker: Player
10.text: "I know that he will not make a mistake."

11.speaker: Petr Vectern
11.text: "I just hope he holds up his end of the bargain..."

12.speaker: Petr Vectern
12.text: "So... You expect your decree to be declared invalid?"

13.speaker: Petr Vectern
13.text: "So... You believe the Court will not push this to the end?"

15.speaker: Player
15.text: "I have to be prepared for the worst."

16.speaker: Player
16.text: "No, the Court cannot afford to do that."

17.speaker: Player
17.text: "Yes. They can't afford to do that."

18.speaker: Player
18.text: "I have to hope for the best."

19.speaker: Petr Vectern
19.text: "If they declare it unconstitutional, they may potentially try to go against you..."

25.speaker: Petr Vectern
25.text: "Well... I don't know. People are uneasy with the current security measures and the opposition is growing..."

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: Petr looked at me and then continued to stare at the ceiling.

28.speaker: Petr Vectern
28.text: "If the Court decides to side with them... You may lose support from our party too."

29.speaker: Petr Vectern
29.text: "You just cannot have the Court against you, Anton. There is no other way but to get them to your side."

30.speaker: Petr Vectern
30.text: "But maybe this period has lasted too long already..."

31.speaker: Petr Vectern
31.text: "The opposition within our party is also growing..."

35.speaker: Petr Vectern
35.text: "Bludish people are getting more discontent than ever... Bergia region is becoming increasingly volatile. The Aschraf anniversary will happen later this year; who knows how that will unfold?"

39.speaker: Petr Vectern
39.text: "Malenyevism is on the increase among the protesters. The fights are continuing despite our security measures."

40.speaker: Petr Vectern
40.text: "Sordish nationalism is on the rise... Increased tensions and violence are going on despite our security measures."

43.speaker: Player
43.text: "Yes, I'm afraid this decree was a bad idea."

46.speaker: Petr Vectern
46.text: "We must think about ways of boosting your image..."

47.speaker: Petr Vectern
47.text: "Maybe cooperating with the Old Guard was a bad idea..."

48.speaker: Petr Vectern
48.text: "I wish I could be as hopeful as you. But I really need something good to happen..."

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: Suddenly, we heard a knock on the door.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: Suddenly, we heard a knock on the door. Lucian came inside and bowed his head slightly.

54.speaker: Lucian Galade
54.text: "The Court has made its decision, sir."

55.speaker: Lucian Galade
55.text: "They found the decree completely legal and ruled Mr. Ricter's complaints invalid."

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: And immediately afterwards, Lucian rushed in, out of breath.

57.speaker: Lucian Galade
57.text: "The Court has made its decision, sir."

58.speaker: Lucian Galade
58.text: "They declared the Emergency invalid and agreed with every complaint of Mr. Ricter regarding your actions being unconstitutional."

59.speaker: Petr Vectern
59.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Order_IncreasedInteriorFunding"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Order_IncreasedInteriorFunding"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Order_DecreasedInteriorFunding"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Order_DecreasedInteriorFunding"] == true) == false)

64.speaker: Player
64.text: "That will show Frens who he's messing with."

65.speaker: Lucian Galade
65.text: "Now we can start thinking about the opposition. They are starting to really provoke the people to go out and protest."

70.speaker: Lucian Galade
70.text: "There is no alternative either way. However, this decree has really damaged your popularity. If the Court sides with the opposition and pushes for it, they may actually impeach you, sir."

71.speaker: Lucian Galade
71.text: "This decree has done a lot of damage. But we can still figure something out to increase the support behind you."

72.speaker: Lucian Galade
72.text: "We have to make sure the Court does not push on investigating Mr. Ricter's claims. This can lead to further chaos and theoretically to your impeachment."

82.speaker: Orso Hawker
82.text: "I told you not to go against the Old Guard, Mr. President."

84.speaker: Orso Hawker
84.text: "Another thing you should know is... The Court has decided to open an investigation on you, Mr. President."

85.speaker: Orso Hawker
85.text: "I wanted to give you the proper respect by letting you know myself."

86.speaker: Player
86.text: "Come on, Mr. Hawker. Don't do this."

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: He hung up the call and I froze with the phone still in my hands.

92.speaker: Lucian Galade
92.text: "Was it the Chief Justice? What did he say?"

94.speaker: Player
94.text: "I am screwed. They are investigating me."

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "Yes. He's going to be a problem."

97.speaker: Lucian Galade
97.text: "Let's think straight. This isn't *so* bad. If they are not directly opening a case to impeach you for this decree, they must have an opposition inside the Court."

100.speaker: Petr Vectern
100.text: "I mean... He has always been a problem."

101.speaker: Lucian Galade
101.text: "We have to make sure the Court stands divided in that. I'll start reaching out to the Justices and find out about their stance and if they're willing to be bribed."

102.speaker: Lucian Galade
102.text: "We have to make sure the Court has no plans to make this a case against you."

103.speaker: Lucian Galade
103.text: "I'll start reaching out to the Justices and find out about their stance and if they're willing to be bribed."

104.speaker: Lucian Galade
104.text: "In the meantime, let's stay focused on our current tasks."

105.speaker: Player
105.text: "You're right. I have complete trust in you guys."

111.speaker: Player
111.text: "No. Orso will pay. I'll involve Mr. Greiser."

112.speaker: Lucian Galade
112.text: "Sir? What do you have in mind?"

114.speaker: Lucian Galade
114.text: "We'll need a proper plan for the remaining of our term."

116.speaker: Lucian Galade
116.text: "You work on boosting your image, sir. We'll do our job and keep you updated."

117.speaker: Petr Vectern
117.text: "I'll talk to Nia. See if she can help."

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: They both left the room and I collapsed on my chair.

122.speaker: Player
122.text: "We need to silence the Court. They need to be given a lesson."

123.speaker: Player
123.text: "It's fine Lucian. I just need to talk to Karl."

124.speaker: Lucian Galade
124.text: "I don't know what you have in mind but it sounds risky, sir."

126.speaker: Player
126.text: "You're right. We can't act so extreme."

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: After a few seconds of ringing, he picked it up.

131.speaker: Player
131.text: "I need you to fix a problem."

132.speaker: Karl Greiser
132.text: "Of course, sir. I am at your command. What is the issue?"

133.speaker: Karl Greiser
133.text: "I am at your command, sir! How can I help you?"

134.speaker: Player
134.text: "Can we get rid of Orso Hawker?"

135.speaker: Player
135.text: "I need the Court Justices to be taught a lesson, so they'd know their place."

137.speaker: Player
137.text: "Yes. Scare them off by any means necessary. Convince them."

138.speaker: Player
138.text: "Threaten them, beat them, do whatever you want."

139.speaker: Player
139.text: "No. Maybe we can't be so reckless."

140.speaker: Karl Greiser
140.text: "As you wish, sir. I'll give the order."

143.speaker: Karl Greiser
143.text: "Do you have anything else in mind?"

144.speaker: Player
144.text: "No, I've changed my mind, Karl. Good day to you."

146.speaker: Karl Greiser
146.text: "Consider it done. Have a good day, sir."

149.speaker: Player
149.text: "Yes. This will teach everyone a lesson."

151.speaker: Karl Greiser
151.text: "If that's the order, sir, of course."

153.speaker: Karl Greiser
153.text: "Are you giving me full approval on this, sir?"

155.speaker: Player
155.text: "No. I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."

157.speaker: Karl Greiser
157.text: "As you wish, sir. I'll execute the order."

162.speaker: Petr Vectern
162.text: "It is really irresponsible of them to invite people to protest on the streets during an emergency. This cannot end well."

163.speaker: Player
163.text: "Let's wait it out. If the worst happens the police would take care of it."

164.speaker: Player
164.text: "We should target the journalists that stir up unrest."

170.speaker: Player
170.text: "We'll start investigations against the opposition leaders."

175.speaker: Lucian Galade
175.text: "Understood. I'll reach out to my connections and make sure nothing about the emergency we do not approve gets published."

176.speaker: Player
176.text: "Detain journalists who have given support to the opposition."

177.speaker: Player
177.text: "No. Just reach out to our connections in media to censor the opposition."

179.speaker: Lucian Galade
179.text: "As you wish, sir. I'll make the necessary calls."

180.speaker: Lucian Galade
180.text: "As you wish, sir. I'll make the necessary preparations."

182.speaker: Lucian Galade
182.text: "Are we really doing this? We still have the intel about him from Orso Hawker too."

183.speaker: Petr Vectern
183.text: "That's true. He has proven connections to Arcasia and has tried to cover his tracks behind international trips for unknown reasons."

184.speaker: Lucian Galade
184.text: "We can justify his arrest. And the decree will allow us to hold him without trial. Antel Rock awaits him if we go through with it."

187.speaker: Player
187.text: "I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."

188.speaker: Lucian Galade
188.text: "If there's nothing else, let's conclude the meeting."

189.speaker: Player
189.text: "Thank you gentlemen, I'll see you later."

190.speaker: Player
190.text: "Before we go... I want to think about some measures again."

192.speaker: Player
192.text: "Never mind. Let's just focus the task at hand."

197.speaker: Lucian Galade
197.text: "If there's nothing else, let's conclude the meeting here."

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: They readied themselves before the door.

204.speaker: Lucian Galade
204.text: "As you wish, sir. I'll make the necessary calls."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: Extending the decree and cooperating with the Old Guard has put me in a very fragile spot, which felt like it could backfire at any moment.

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: Cooperating with the Old Guard, even for a short time, has put me in a very fragile spot, which felt like it could backfire at any moment.

217.speaker: Petr Vectern
217.text: "So... You expect an actual trial against you?"

221.speaker: Petr Vectern
221.text: "I can't believe this... You did what they asked."

222.speaker: Petr Vectern
222.text: "It's absurd that they did not protest when you declared the emergency and now they're reviewing a past case."

223.speaker: Petr Vectern
223.text: "We can't face a negative outcome from the supreme Court..."

227.speaker: Petr Vectern
227.text: "Well... I don't know. The emergency was not very popular before and that fed into the rise of the opposition."

228.speaker: Petr Vectern
228.text: "If the Court decides to side with the opposition for once... You may lose support from everyone. Including the USP."

235.speaker: Petr Vectern
235.text: "How about the Bludish issue? The emergency did not really help with the situation in Bergia. It has become even more volatile. The Aschraf anniversary will happen later this year; who knows how that will unfold?"

239.speaker: Petr Vectern
239.text: "I'm afraid we also contributed to the radicalization of the malenyevists on our soil..."
239.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_RY"] == true)

240.speaker: Petr Vectern
240.text: "I'm afraid we also contributed to the radicalization of the Sordish nationalists..."
240.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_RY"] == true) == false)

244.speaker: Lucian Galade
244.text: "Now we can start thinking about what to do next and how to get out of this hole we put ourselves in. The opposition gained a lot of popularity throughout this process."

245.speaker: Lucian Galade
245.text: "I'll arrange a cabinet meeting to address all the issues and our next steps as soon as possible."

247.speaker: Player
247.text: "The quicker we get together, the better."

249.speaker: Lucian Galade
249.text: "With all due respect, I disagree sir. The main demand of the people were to pursue constitutional reforms. Not only we did not follow through with that..."

251.speaker: Lucian Galade
251.text: "...We ended up making powerful enemies. Now if the Supreme Court wants us gone, they could potentially do that very easily."

256.speaker: Lucian Galade
256.text: "They declared the Emergency decree illegal and agreed with every complaint of Mr. Ricter regarding your actions being unconstitutional."

258.speaker: Player
258.text: "Let's finish the meeting here. I'll make a short phone call."

260.speaker: Livia Suno
260.text: "Good day to you, Mr. President. Am I interrupting anything?"

263.speaker: Player
263.text: "No. Please come in. Is there a problem?"

266.speaker: Player
266.text: "Yeah. A picture of Tarquin Soll. What a nice present!"

267.speaker: Petr Vectern
267.text: "Victory will be close, huh? Orso's getting ahead of himself."

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: She walked up and gave it to me. I immediately started to remove the wrapping to reveal a framed photograph.

270.speaker: Player
270.text: "This must be some kind of a message."

271.speaker: Livia Suno
271.text: "The Chief Justice has sent you this."

272.speaker: Narrator
272.text: She showed me the wrapped object.

273.speaker: Player
273.text: "Thank you, Livia. You can leave it on my table."

274.speaker: Player
274.text: "Really? From Orso Hawker? Bring it here."

276.speaker: Narrator
276.text: Noticing Petr on the couch, Livia reddened slightly. She gave a small wave, which Petr returned.

278.speaker: Livia Suno
278.text: "No, but he's obviously trying to send you a message. I--"

279.speaker: Livia Suno
279.text: "He's obviously trying to send you a message, but--"

285.speaker: Player
285.text: "Did Orso say anything to you about this?"

286.speaker: Narrator
286.text: As soon as she left the room, Petr came right next to me and took a look at the photograph.

287.speaker: Livia Suno
287.text: "Mr. Vice President. I'll be leaving now."

289.speaker: Narrator
289.text: It was an old black and white photograph of Tarquin Soll posing on a destroyed tank at the Holsord Square. The building behind him had thousands of bullet holes on it. To the side a clearly readable slogan 'Victory is close' written on its walls.

290.speaker: Player
290.text: "What do you think this means, Livia?"

291.speaker: Narrator
291.text: The date, 14 March 1929 was written on the corner with a black marker.

349.speaker: Player
349.text: "No. Orso will pay. I'll involve... a group of *fixers.*"

350.speaker: Lucian Galade
350.text: "Sir? What do you have in mind?"

352.speaker: Player
352.text: "It's fine, Lucian. I just need to make a phone call."

360.speaker: Narrator
360.text: After a few seconds of ringing, he picked it up.

363.speaker: Player
363.text: "I need you to fix a problem."

365.speaker: Remus Holstron
365.text: "Oh, Mr. President! How can I help you?"

366.speaker: Player
366.text: "Can you get rid of Orso Hawker?"

367.speaker: Player
367.text: "I need the Court Justices to be taught a lesson. I want them to know their place."

368.speaker: Remus Holstron
368.text: "I see. They are stepping on your toes. You want them scared off?"

369.speaker: Player
369.text: "Yes. Scare them off by any means necessary. Convince them."

370.speaker: Player
370.text: "Threaten them, beat them, do whatever you want."

371.speaker: Player
371.text: "No. Maybe we can't be so reckless."

372.speaker: Remus Holstron
372.text: "I don't know if it will work. But we can try."

375.speaker: Remus Holstron
375.text: "Do you have anything else in mind?"

376.speaker: Player
376.text: "No, I've changed my mind. Good day to you."

378.speaker: Remus Holstron
378.text: "I see. He stepped on your toes too. You want him completely *gone*?"

380.speaker: Player
380.text: "Yes. This will teach everyone a lesson."

382.speaker: Remus Holstron
382.text: "I'll talk to my people. See what I can do."

383.speaker: Player
383.text: "No. I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."

386.speaker: Remus Holstron
386.text: "Are you giving me full approval on this, Mr. President?"

387.speaker: Remus Holstron
387.text: "I understand. Next time, call me when you are sure about what to ask for.
